name: Stine Neerup
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
description: I am an animal-assisted relational therapist. My approach to therapy is trauma-informed, gender inclusive, neuro-affirming, and collaborative. I see clients with relational issues, trauma, ADHD, autism, a 2E profile, anxiety, OCD, and depression.

name: Sudhir Dean
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: I am a Level 4 ACA Counsellor and Supervisor. I have worked in multiple areas (Asylum Seekers and Refugees, AOD, Trauma, Mental Health, Elder Abuse and more). I ultimately take an existential approach but am trained and have worked with trauma for many years. I have recently completed a Level 3 training in Deep Brain Reorienting, which is a profound somatic approach to healing trauma and releasing shock.

name: Tanja Ben-Meir
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: With nearly 20 years of experience, I am a trained and skilled listener. In the simplest of terms I take what you tell me, and process it with you, step by step, to help you move beyond what brought you to me in the first place. I am warm and open minded with a sometimes quirky sense of humour.

name: Thalia Giannake

description: Hi! I’m Queer, Neurodivergent and Disabled. My counselling practice is inclusive, and queer- and neuro-affirming, always.

name: Tonya Planigale
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: Hi, I’m Tonya Planigale. I am a professional counsellor based in the northeast Melbourne. I welcome all forms of diversity in my practice: age, religion and faith, gender and sexuality, cultural diversity, neurodiversity, and people with diverse family structures and caring responsibilities.
